page.content:
The Buckies are a group of three Nokis found in Pinna Park in Super Mario Sunshine. They are named Ducky, Lucky, and Plucky, who have the appearance of a regular red, green, and blue Noki, respectively.

page.overview:
Who is Buckies?

The Buckies are a group of three Nokis found in Pinna Park in Super Mario Sunshine. They are named Ducky, Lucky, and Plucky, who have the appearance of a regular red, green, and blue Noki, respectively.

Though the Buckies do not return in Mario Superstar Baseball, red, blue, and green are all a color option for the playable Noki.
